comment: Nicest professor ever; cares so much about her students. The activities in class are very engaging and interesting. Cannot recommend enough.

I had Professor Cassada for my FYS, Angst Years: Hormones, High Anxiety and Happiness. She is my favorite teacher that I have had at Richmond so far! It is clear that she cares immensely for all of her students. The class was very interesting and well structured. I felt that all of the assignments were beneficial to my learning (not just busywork)

Dr.Cassada is the nicest teacher ever!! She really cares about her students and tries to connect with them all. While I was struggling in her class because of personal issues and wasn't turning assignments in on time, she reached out to me to meet with her and we talked through it. She gave me the opportunity to make it up, and I ended up with an A
She's the best. 100% would take again.

Professor Cassada is my favorite teacher at Richmond. She is so thoughtful, caring, and understanding of her students. This FYS was knowledgeable and interesting. She is very committed to being aware of her students wellbeing. She allows for corrections on papers and gives great feedback. Definitely take her class!!

Dr. Cassada is a great professor. Definitely take her fall FYS option, "Angst Years: Hormones, High Anxiety, & Happiness. She makes it known that if you show up and do the work, then you will do well in the class. Her class is engaging, she is a chill professor, she is always reaching out and available, and she understands college first-years well.

I loved having Kate as my FYS teacher for Angst Yrs. She did not overwhelm me with work, but I still do feel like I got a lot out of the class. There are 6 two page papers and 1 two page editorial, as well as several group projects (all not too difficult). This is a hard class to get, but try if you can. Would take again if I could!

Dr. Kate is one of those teachers who make you want to stay in her class your entire time at college. I took her for my FYS "angst years" and I can wholeheartedly say that she is one of the most genuine human beings on planet earth. She cares about each student 100% and makes the course material come to life. She has changed my life. Take her!
